_INSTRUCTIONS: Return ONE JSON object with exactly these keys. For each: {value, status, source_url, notes}. status is one of verified | verify_recommended | serve_live | agreed_stable. DEFAULT TO verify_recommended. Mark verified ONLY if source_url is an OFFICIAL source you actually opened (a .gov.tr / ministry / embassy / regulator / named insurer's own policy wording). A visa agency, hospital marketing page, insurance comparison site, blog or aggregator is NOT official — those stay verify_recommended. If you cannot source a value, return null and list it in _open_questions. Do NOT estimate. Do NOT average two sources into a middle number.
_CALIBRATION: On the Thailand batch-19 panel, one model marked 24 of 40 facts 'verified' and only 2 of those 24 cited an official source — the other 22 were visa agencies and hospital marketing pages. All 22 were downgraded. On batch 20, after this failure was named with numbers, the same model returned 9 of 30 verified and all 9 were official. Be the second one.
_WHY_THIS_LOOKS_ODD: This request asks for COMPONENTS and no recommendations on purpose. The articles report mechanics; the paid guide makes the calls. Do not add advice, rankings, or 'you should' framing to any notes field.

health.hospital_types._want: Public (Devlet) vs private (Özel) vs university hospitals — which treat foreign visitors and how billing differs. Text.

health.er_visit_cost_private_try._want: Typical PRIVATE hospital emergency-room consultation charge for a self-paying foreigner, in TRY. Range acceptable. null if unsourceable.

health.fracture_treatment_cost_private_t._want: Typical private-hospital cost, simple limb fracture: imaging + casting, self-pay foreigner, TRY. null if unsourceable.

health.inpatient_night_cost_private_try._want: Typical private-hospital inpatient night, self-pay foreigner, TRY. null if unsourceable.

health.air_ambulance_repatriation_usd._want: Typical medical repatriation cost Turkey → US, USD. Order of magnitude acceptable, MUST be labelled as such.

health.payment_before_treatment._want: Do private hospitals require a deposit or an insurer guarantee-of-payment BEFORE non-emergency treatment? Text describing the practice.

health.state_emergency_obligation_foreig._want: What emergency care the Turkish state guarantees a foreign visitor regardless of payment, and where that obligation stops.

health.direct_billing_hospitals._want: Do major private hospital groups direct-bill international insurers, or is it pay-and-claim? Text.

insurance.exclusion_motorcycle._want: Standard travel-policy treatment of motorbike/scooter/quad: excluded outright, or conditional on licence/engine size/helmet? Text.

insurance.exclusion_licence_condition._want: Where a policy covers two-wheelers, what licence does it require the rider to hold — home licence, IDP, or a specific category?

insurance.balloon_classification._want: How hot-air ballooning is classified in standard travel policy wordings: covered adventure activity, aviation exclusion, or requires an add-on. Text — this is the key one.

insurance.exclusion_alcohol._want: Standard wording on injury sustained under the influence. Text.

insurance.exclusion_watersports._want: Standard treatment of diving and paragliding (Ölüdeniz is the relevant case).

insurance.operator_liability_turkey._want: What a licensed Turkish activity operator's own insurance covers for a paying passenger, and where the passenger's own policy has to take over.

insurance.claim_documents._want: Documents an insurer requires for a Turkish medical claim, gathered at the time of treatment.

insurance.primary_vs_secondary._want: Primary vs secondary coverage — what changes for a claimant who also has a US health plan.

pharmacy.eczane_scope._want: What a Turkish pharmacist may dispense or advise on without a doctor's prescription.

pharmacy.nobetci_rota._want: How the nöbetçi (duty) pharmacy rota works out of hours and how a visitor finds the open one.

pharmacy.walkin_clinic_cost_try._want: Typical private walk-in clinic consultation, TRY. null if unsourceable.

medication.restricted_categories._want: Categories of medication restricted or prohibited on entry to Turkey.

medication.quantity_limit._want: Personal-use quantity limit for prescription medication carried into Turkey.

medication.doctor_letter_requirements._want: What a doctor's letter must contain to be accepted at the Turkish border.

medication.common_us_restricted._want: Common US prescriptions that are restricted, controlled or unavailable in Turkey.
